title: Relation between mass and energy (ভর ও শক্তির সম্পর্ক)
placement: Book page 119, topic 4.6: ৪.৬ ভর ও শক্তির সম্পর্ক (Relation between mass and energy). Next to চিত্র ৪.০৬ (নিউক্লিয়ার বিক্রিয়ায় শক্তি উৎপাদন) and the equation ¹₀n + ²³⁵₉₂U → ⁹²₃₆Kr + ¹⁴¹₅₆Ba + 3¹₀n, with the paragraphs on E = mc², the chain reaction and the power plant.
description: Interactive 3D figure for textbook topic 4.6 (page 119), the book's চিত্র ৪.০৬ brought to life in three scenes. (1) একটি নিউক্লিয়াস: in the deep blue water of a reactor pool, a slow neutron flies into a glowing uranium-235 nucleus of 92 red protons (with +) and 143 grey neutrons; the nucleus takes it in, becomes unstable (অস্থিতিশীল), wobbles, stretches into a dumbbell and splits into ⁹²Kr and ¹⁴¹Ba (their own balls, 36 p + 56 n and 56 p + 85 n, flying apart with equal and opposite momentum) and three fast neutrons with streaks, with a flash and the book's yellow star of শক্তি. The panel shows the book's equation with each side's mass (236.0526 u and 235.8667 u, AME2020 atomic masses) and a small balance that tips to the heavier left side, and works E = mc² out with the missing 0.1859 u (3.09 × 10⁻²⁸ kg): 2.78 × 10⁻¹¹ J for one nucleus. (2) চেইন রি-অ্যাকশন: the three neutrons, slowed on their way, split three more nuclei, whose nine neutrons split nine more (1 → 3 → 9, 13 splits and their energy). Both play from the big action button and can be replayed and scrubbed with a slider or the arrow keys. (3) শক্তিকেন্দ্র: a nuclear power plant on a river bank at dusk, cut open: the control rods rise, the core glows blue in its water, steam runs to the turbine, the turbine and generator turn, power runs along the lines and a town's windows light up. The student picks the fuel's mass (1 g to 1 kg of uranium-235) and whether it is split (0.079% of its mass becomes energy) or turned fully into energy as E = mc² says; the panel gives E in J (c = 3 × 10⁸ m/s, as the book) and how long it would light a 100 W bulb. Sizes and times are not to scale (said in the panel). Five scene-based test questions. The nucleus exports as GLB (1 cm = 1 fm). Offline, Bangla and English.
